'''Carl Mike Hardy HB Shoot 'Em Up''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''HB Shoot 'Em Up'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it on 25 April 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' HB Shoot 'Em Up


== Introduction ==

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

What's the best way to deal with Zuckuss in Mist Hunter? Blow him straight to Mars! This is a deck that is actually the way Hidden Base was meant to be. It's a space deck through and through! Hidden Base gets in trouble when Security Precautions come into play. Being able to blow away the Dark's probe ships, you may have a chance to keep your hidden base hidden.
